definitions.explanation: A woman considered to be physically attractive. Traditionally used specifically for women.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美人|びじん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{美人|びじん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{美人|びじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: A beautiful woman will bore you after three days. (Proverb: looks aren't everything)

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{美人|びじん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦そうです→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: I hear her mother is also beautiful.

examples.japanese: {秋田|あきた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美人|びじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Akita is said to have many beautiful women.

notes:
{美人|びじん} refers specifically to a beautiful woman.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {美人|びじん}な + noun (beautiful ~)
- ⟦{絶世|ぜっせい}→絶世：17116_zessei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美人|びじん} (a peerless beauty)
- {秋田|あきた}{美人|びじん} (Akita beauty - famous for beautiful women)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美人|びじん}: beautiful woman (physical beauty)
- ⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧: beautiful woman (more literary)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: pretty/beautiful person
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: handsome man (modern slang)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Certain regions in Japan are traditionally known for {美人|びじん}, such as Akita and Kyoto.
